title: Folio 3: The Blind King Who Ruled Twice | The Honest Historian – Stories from Beyhaqi
description:
A Sultan who reigned for five months is locked in a fortress by his own brother, and the world forgets him. Ten years later, a mutinous army drags him out and crowns him again. This is the strange fate of Amir Muhammad, son of Mahmud of Ghazni, and of the brother who took his throne.

7:12 Foolish is the man
8:07 The town of victory
9:08 Fortune keeps the key
10:17 Next week

Source: Tarikh-e Beyhaqi (Muhammad in the fortress after Tiginabad, 421 AH / 1030 CE; Masud's departure for India after Dandanqan, 431-432 AH / 1040 CE), with the later chroniclers for the mutiny at Marikala, Masud's death at Giri and Mawdud's victory near Nangarhar (432 AH / 1041 CE).
Retold in English from the Persian original by Mehdi Rahmani and narrated with an AI rendering of his own voice.
